name: CM34_emulation_effects_are_the_shell
origins: user requirement 2026-10-21 (input, video, audio and saves an unchanged effect shell)
statement: A machine module performs no I/O: every call stays inside it. Video, audio, input, battery saves and the wall clock are the effect shell around it (machine/shell.py), which is never lifted, specialised or optimised; what the shell shows and streams is exactly the machine's own frame.
